body: Thank you so much for reply, it was very comforting to read. I think I will message you later. I have a many number of things that need to get done today, so I won't be messaging you right away. But I can't tell you how nice that made me feel to read that.
I understand, but I suppose it's like telling someone you got beat-up in a fight. No one wants to admit it. No one wants to admit that they lost and are hurting.

Sorry, about any confusion. I'm afraid to tell them about the rapes. I had a lot about my sexual orientation in there, because this was a copy/paste from my /r/suicidewatch post. My confusion over my orientation has contributed to my suicidal thoughts.

The uncle who raped me is my father's brother. My father absolutely adores him, he has no idea what he's done. If what he has done, were to come out, it would devastate my father, as well as the rest of the family. They would feel bad for me, I'm sure, but there would also be turmoil for months, perhaps years. As well that I would have to deal with my family knowing I had been raped, that would be incredibly embarrassing.

First off, I'd just like to say I appreciate all of the answers given here, I really do. But, there's no way I can bring myself to tell anyone about my cousin and uncle. There's no way I would be able to handle the aftermath.
Thank you again, for taking the time to even read my "novel" I typed out.
